title: CDN: edge, origin and content purging

videos.script: A reader in Lisbon opens the bookshop. The server is in São Paulo. Every request crosses an ocean and comes back. {{distance}} No setting on the server makes that trip shorter. What makes it shorter is answering from Lisbon. {{closer}} That is a content delivery network. Caches in hundreds of cities, between your visitors and your server. Your server becomes the origin. {{cdn}} Everything you know about shared caches applies to an edge. But you do not run it, and that changes how you purge, how you debug, and what you trust. {{rules}} In this lesson you build a small edge of your own, with Varnish, in front of Nginx. You see what it refuses to keep, how its key decides who shares a copy, and how one request purges every page that shows a changed price. {{edge}} And you stop the origin, and watch the edge keep the shop open. {{grace}}
